results.name: The server draws the skeleton of the page the address names, and never the Companies page (a reload used to flash it first)
Without any script the first paint is the skeleton: shimmering blocks, no content
A slow reload never shows another page: every frame is the skeleton, then the page that was asked for
Every skeleton block shares one sweep (pinned to the viewport), in the colors of the theme
Reduced motion shows static placeholders; the text variant stays readable
The skeleton shows after a short delay, so a fast load never flashes it; the label is announced politely
Phone: the skeletons fit the screen without horizontal scroll
The page that arrives replaces the skeleton for real: every section loads without errors after a normal reload
